body.x: Lima(www.meetlima.com), a developer of revolutionary and innovative technology, unveiled "Lima" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Lima consists of a hardware adapter and a multi-platform app to enables users to synchronize the files on their devices, whether it is a smartphone, computer, or tablet. All your devices will be synchronized automatically once Lima is installed, saving the time and effort from manually uploading files on the cloud.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
